vibe_rationale: Community-owned, deeply rooted First Nations art fair with curated art centres and a public program, though a convention-centre format with narrower scope.
fit_notes: Art collectors, cultural tourists and locals make up an adult-leaning audience with weak wellness adjacency. A named partnerships contact and a long partner list show it is seeking partners, but any High Ground role must be First Nations-led and respectful, such as supporting artists or the public program.
